statements.status_notes: No fixed upstream Kyverno release is currently available. Scout's affected range covers the packaged 1.15.x and 1.16.x branches. The +dirty BuildInfo PURL covers the same kyverno binary surface as @1.15.3. Tracking upstream.

Upstream fix ships in Kyverno 1.17.0 (the prior 1.16.4 fix-version note in the original statement does not align with current Scout advisory data, which still flags 1.16.4). The packaged 1.15.3 and 1.16.4 releases preserve the 1.15.x and 1.16.x branches and no upstream backport is available. The +dirty BuildInfo PURL covers the same kyverno binary surface as @1.15.3. Tracking upstream.

GHSA-qr4g-8hrp-c4rw is the unrestricted-outbound-request variant of the kyverno apiCall SSRF family. reports-server imports only kyverno type packages and the generated clientset; it does not import or execute pkg/engine/apicall, so the vulnerable code path is not shipped.

GHSA-gg4x-fgg2-h9w9 is a policy-exception bypass in the kyverno policy engine. reports-server does not evaluate policies or policy exceptions; it imports only kyverno type packages and the generated clientset, so pkg/engine and pkg/controllers/policyexceptions are not shipped.
